symbols.notes: 19041.3758, 20348.2582, 22000.194, 22621.6630 and 26100.8972: native virtual cloning publishes a newly created CAccent after policy/atlas initialization, without copying ParentVisible. Preserve CloneOptions and HRESULT, including the native state-3 policy exclusion on 19041/20348. The audited entry has vtable references and no direct code callers; indirect callers use the ordinary virtual-call ABI. On 26100.8972 InitializeVisualTreeClone always replays the source policy and ignores CloneOptions. Glass-only descendants receive bit 3 unchanged through CContainerVisual; transparent-gradient state 2 with zero gradient/animation avoids background resources while retaining the native border/shadow flags.

symbols.name: Symbol_CRenderDataVisual_CloneVisualTree_Pre19041
symbols.notes: 17763.719/18362.267 CAccent::CloneVisualTree rebuilds policy rather than copying render instructions. For overridden state 1 this recreates a black native fill before owner association. The CRenderDataVisual base clone creates its own destination, clones source transforms/children through CVisual, then retains each current instruction with AddInstruction. Native ClearInstructions/destruction releases those references. Use this rendered snapshot for an existing OpenGlass override in a full-window capture. Glass-only LivePreview instead uses the native state-3 background exclusion, retaining optional border/shadow atlas children; unmodified Accent keeps its native policy/visibility clone path.
